label: Counting entries from topology
subgoals: Count the pins and internal nodes of the network
Subtract one from the node count to get the resistor count
Add ground capacitors and couplings for the CAP count

label: Totals and units
subgoals: Read the capacitance unit from the header
Sum the entries and compare with the header total

label: Elmore delay from the entries
subgoals: Order the resistors from the driver to the sink
Accumulate the capacitance downstream of each resistor
Sum resistance times downstream capacitance in picoseconds
